data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Kiran' meaning 'ray of light' or 'shining'. The name Kiara carries the meaning “Radiant, Shining” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Kiara usually hope their child will grow to embody radiant, shining and live with faith, good character and purpose.
